z-k-01-01.title: Di bill match di order?
z-k-01-01.topic: Ordering food: counting words and prices
z-k-01-01.goal: Check short order dialogue against menu, find first line wey amount no match, then design your own orders wey fit one budget.
z-k-01-01.material:
Small café get this menu (원 = won, Korean money).
커피 한 잔: 3,000원
빵 한 개: 2,000원

손님 = customer, 직원 = worker. Read di dialogue.

손님: 커피 두 잔 주세요.
직원: 네. 커피 두 잔, 6,000원이에요.
손님: 그리고 빵 세 개 주세요.
직원: 네. 빵 세 개, 5,000원이에요.
직원: 모두 11,000원이에요.
z-k-01-01.thinking.0: Check statement against facts wey dem give
z-k-01-01.thinking.1: Find where mistake start and wetin e affect after
z-k-01-01.thinking.2: Make different orders wey meet same limits
z-k-01-01.prereq.1: E know counting words 한, 두, 세, 다섯 ... with 개 and 잔
z-k-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Which line na FIRST one wey amount no match menu?
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Take one item each time: find price for menu, then compare with amount worker talk.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: First check 커피 line to see correct example, then check 빵 line same way.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.explain: Line 4 na first mistake: 빵 cost 2,000원 each, so three breads cost 6,000원, no be 5,000원. Line 2 correct (two coffees at 3,000원). Line 5 add line 2 and line 4 correctly, but e start from wrong bread amount, so e wrong too; e no be separate mistake.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Customer go pay amount for last line. Wetin worker last line suppose talk?
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Calculate correct amount for each item separately.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Then compare total with 11,000원 for bill.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.a: Maybe you read 세 개 as 두 개. Compare number customer talk with number wey you use.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.b: This one repeat amounts wey worker talk. Sum correct, but one amount wey dem add no correct.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.c: This one come from checking each item against menu first, then adding amounts.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.explain: Coffee 2 x 3,000 = 6,000 and bread 3 x 2,000 = 6,000, so total na 12,000원. Worker 11,000원 na correct sum from wrong bread amount.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.prompt: You get exactly 13,000원 and wan spend all on 커피 (c cups) and 빵 (b pieces). Order at least one each and at most 6 items altogether. Find two different orders.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: First choose number of coffees, then see how much money remain for bread.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: If remaining money no be multiple of 2,000, change coffee number.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Whole numbers, at least one of each.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Use whole numbers, with at least one cup and one piece.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Bill no be 13,000원 (커피 3,000원 each, 빵 2,000원 each).
z-k-01-01.s.s3.explain: Two orders fit: 커피 1 + 빵 5 (3,000 + 10,000) and 커피 3 + 빵 2 (9,000 + 4,000). If 커피 2, bill na 12,000원, and 커피 5 already cost more than 13,000원 together with one bread.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.prompt: Tell clerk one of your orders for Korean. Use both items, their counting words, and 주세요.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.hint.0: Say coffee first, then bread, then finish with 주세요.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.hint.1: Count coffee with 잔 and bread with 개.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: My order use the counts from one of my two orders from previous step?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: 커피 go with 잔 and 빵 go with 개?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Clerk know exactly wetin to bring?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Use 하고 to join the two items.

z-k-01-02.thinking.1: Change conclusion when new information come
z-k-01-02.title: Who be teacher for this class?
z-k-01-02.goal: Narrow down the teacher from short self-introductions, notice when new sentence clash with your answer, and write sentence wey fix the clash.
z-k-01-02.material: Three people dey Korean class: 민호, 에밀리 and 켄. One na teacher; other two students. Every person get only one nationality (한국 사람 = Korean, 미국 사람 = American). Everybody tell truth for first two clues. Clues come one by one.
z-k-01-02.thinking.2: Handle clues wey no fit all be true
z-k-01-02.prereq.2: Know words 학생, 선생님, 한국 사람, 미국 사람
z-k-01-02.s.s1.prompt: After every clue, choose the most sensible thought.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.0: Before you choose, talk with your own words wetin each sentence include or rule out.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.1: After every new clue, check if e agree with all the things you already know.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.after: 아니에요 rule out 에밀리 only. 민호 and 켄 still fit be.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Notice say one ‘is not’ rule out one person, and leave others possible.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Treat ‘not 에밀리’ like ‘must be 켄’ even though nobody talk anything about 민호.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: No notice 아니에요, wey mean ‘is not’.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Teacher Korean, 켄 American and 에밀리 say she no be teacher, so 민호 remain.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: No notice say 켄 say teacher Korean when he himself American.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Put clue 1 (not 에밀리) together with clue 2 (teacher Korean, 켄 American).
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wetin be most sensible thing to do now?
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.after: If everybody dey tell truth, nobody fit be teacher: 에밀리 no be, 켄 no be Korean, and 민호 say he student. So one sentence wrong or person misunderstand am. Ask again or keep 민호 as less certain answer both fair; ignoring clue no be.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Keep 민호 as my best guess, but ask am again.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Keep answer with strongest support, lower confidence and check the source.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: All clues no fit be true. I go check wetin each person really talk.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Notice say four sentences clash, so one must be wrong or misunderstood.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Na 켄 be teacher after all. His nationality no matter.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Throw away clue because e dey in the way.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.reflect: First clue rule out one person, second choose one, third contradict the choice. Clash between clues na information too: e tell you to check the sentences instead of choosing answer wey you like.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.prompt: Write one Korean sentence wey 민호 fit talk instead of ‘저는 학생이에요’, so all clues go agree and he be teacher.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.0: Which word for 민호 last sentence clash with other clues?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.1: Replace only that word and keep ending 이에요.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: E still agree say 민호 Korean and with other clues?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Repeat his nationality, then new information.

z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c1: Use whole dates and whole hours.
z-k-01-11.title: Notice wey fit mean two things
z-k-01-11.topic: Scope of negation with 모두 ... -지 않다
z-k-01-11.goal: Find wetin notice definitely say under both readings, update your view as facts arrive, find attendance counts wey fit, and rewrite notice to leave only one meaning.
z-k-01-11.material:
Club get 10 members (president 회장 na one of 10). Club rule (in English): meeting fit happen only if at least 6 of 10 members come. Notice go up after meeting day:
‘오늘 회의에는 회원이 모두 참석하지 않았습니다.’
Sentence fit read two ways. Reading A: no member come. Reading B: no be every member come (some come, some no). Facts go arrive one by one.
z-k-01-11.thinking.0: Notice sentence fit have two meanings
z-k-01-11.thinking.1: Keep safe conclusion and narrow am with facts
z-k-01-11.prereq.0: Know 모두 (all) and 아무도 / 한 명도 (nobody)
z-k-01-11.prereq.1: Know negative -지 않다 and formal -습니다 style
z-k-01-11.s.s1.prompt: After every piece of information, choose most sensible thought.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.0: Ask wetin true in Reading A and Reading B, then keep only wetin true for both.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.1: After every fact, check which reading e contradict.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.info: The notice above na all you know.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wetin you sure of under BOTH meanings?
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.after: With A everybody absent, and with B some absent, ‘at least one member absent’ true in both. Nothing else certain yet.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Choose reading A as if na the only one.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Find wetin both readings share: A and B both leave somebody out.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Add number wey notice no give.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Everybody agree say club president (회장) dey the meeting.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Which reading no fit be true now?
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.after: If president come, ‘nobody came’ false. Reading B, ‘some came and some no’, still fit.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Reading B: some come and some no.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: President dey there fit B, so e no rule B out.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Use fact say one member come to rule out ‘nobody came’.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.info: 회의는 열리지 못했습니다. (The meeting could not be held.)
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: How many members come, using club rule?
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.after: At least 1 come (the president) and fewer than 6 (otherwise meeting for happen), so between 1 and 5.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Put ‘at least one’ together with ‘fewer than six’.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Forget say at least 6 members need to come for meeting happen.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.reflect: First answer safe because e true for both readings. Every new fact remove one possibility, so you fit be more exact. You no need guess writer meaning to say wetin certain.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.prompt: Give two possible attendance counts wey fit all three facts: x members come and y absent (10 altogether). The two counts must have different x values.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.hint.0: Start from lowest and highest number wey facts allow.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c2: x and y add up to 10 members.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.fail.c2: x and y must add to 10.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c3: At least one member (the president) come.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.fail.c3: At least one member come (the president).
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c4: Fewer than 6 come, so meeting no fit happen.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.fail.c4: 6 or more for be enough to hold the meeting.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.explain: Any x from 1 to 5 work (with y = 10 - x). No allow 0 because president come, and no allow 6 or more because meeting no happen.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.prompt: Rewrite notice for Korean two times: one sentence wey only mean ‘nobody came’, and one wey only mean ‘not everybody came’.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.hint.0: For ‘nobody’, use word wey mean ‘not even one’.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.hint.1: For ‘not everybody’, say who come or say ‘no be everybody come’.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My first sentence mean only say nobody come?
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My second sentence mean only say some people no come?
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Reader still fit dey unsure about either one?

z-k-01-04.title: Which stop be ‘the third stop’?
z-k-01-04.topic: Give and follow directions on subway line
z-k-01-04.goal: Decide wetin friend directions leave unclear, use new messages to reduce options, and ask missing questions for Korean.
z-k-01-04.material:
민아 dey go 지우 school by subway. Line 2 stop in this order from left to right:
가역 - 나역 - 다역 - 라역 - 마역 - 바역 - 사역
민아 house dey beside 라역, so she board at 라역. 지우 send three messages. Dem arrive one by one.
z-k-01-04.thinking.2: Ask questions to get missing facts
z-k-01-04.prereq.0: Know 타세요 / 내리세요 and 세 번째
z-k-01-04.prereq.1: Know 쪽 (direction) and 앞 (in front of)
z-k-01-04.prereq.2: Fit read list of stations in order
z-k-01-04.s.s1.prompt: After every message, choose most sensible thought.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Write stations on a line and mark 라역. Count to third station on each side.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Before choosing, ask yourself wetin 지우 must add to make only one station possible.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 민아 sure where to get off?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.after: If you no count 라역, third station na 가역 on left and 사역 on right. Direction missing.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yes: ‘the third stop’ name only one station.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Count in one direction only and forget say line go both ways.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: No: message no say which direction to ride.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Notice say third station on left and third on right different.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: No: message no say how many minutes ride go take.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Look for detail wey no fit change which station na third.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Which station be ‘the third station’ for 민아, wey board at 라역?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Plenty people no count station where you board, so e make 사역; some count am, so e make 바역. Choosing 사역 na good guess, and uncertainty make sense too. Safest thing na ask.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Start counting from next station after where she enter.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Count station where she enter as first one.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: I no fit sure: e depend on whether dem count 라역 itself.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Notice say two ways to count dey, and nobody mention which one.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wetin this tell you about how 지우 count am?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.after: School dey at 사역. Only if you count 마역 (1), 바역 (2), 사역 (3) you reach there, so 지우 no count station where you board.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 지우 count 라역 as first station.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: If that true, third station go be 바역, no be school station.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: School location no say anything about counting.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: School station show which counting method get the right stop.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 지우 no count 라역, the station where you board.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Use school station to choose between two counting ways.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.reflect: First message leave direction unclear, second leave counting unclear, third settle counting. Notice each answer safe only when you say wetin you no know yet.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.prompt: At beginning 민아 only get first message. Write Korean question(s) she fit send to get both missing facts.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.hint.0: Write one question for each missing fact.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.hint.1: Think how 지우 fit answer each one with short reply.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Dem get how to count stations?
z-k-01-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: 지우 fit answer each question shortly?
z-k-01-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Name direction guess first, then how to count.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.modelNote.2: Direction first, then number of stops.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.modelNote.3: Ask where destination dey, and that go settle both facts.

z-k-01-03.title: One reason enough?
z-k-01-03.topic: Give reasons with -아서/어서 and clock times
z-k-01-03.goal: Check stated reason (-아서/어서) against clock times, change your view when second fact show, and write all reasons for Korean.
z-k-01-03.material:
서연 go watch movie. 영화는 7시에 시작했어요 (movie start at 7:00). 서연이 친구에게 말했어요: ‘지하철이 안 와서 늦었어요.’

서연의 이야기:
- 6시 10분에 집에서 나갔어요. 역은 집 바로 앞이에요.
- 역에서 지하철을 20분 기다렸어요.
- 지하철은 보통 40분 걸려요.
- 극장은 지하철역 바로 앞이에요.
z-k-01-03.thinking.1: Ask wetin go happen without the reason
z-k-01-03.thinking.2: Change judgement when new fact appear
z-k-01-03.prereq.0: Know clock times (6시 10분) and past tense -았/었어요
z-k-01-03.s.s1.prompt: Using only these facts, how good be reason ‘지하철이 안 와서 늦었어요’?
z-k-01-03.s.s1.hint.0: Write clock time after every part of her trip: leaving, waiting, riding.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.hint.1: Then repeat the trip once without the wait and compare with 7:00.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.o.a: No good: leaving house at 6:10 don already too late for 7:00 movie.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.r.a: No add travel time: 6:10 plus 40 minutes na 6:50, on time.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.o.b: Good: without the wait she for don reach by 6:50, on time.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.r.b: Compare wetin happen with wetin for happen without the reason.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.o.c: No fit say: facts no tell how long the ride take.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.r.c: Miss say ‘보통 40분 걸려요’ give usual ride time.
z-k-01-03.s.s1.explain: She leave by 6:10, wait 20 minutes (6:30), then ride 40 minutes, so she reach 7:10, 10 minutes late. Without wait, she for reach by 6:50, before 7:00. So wait fully explain why she late in this case.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.prompt: New information: 그날 지하철은 사고 때문에 천천히 가서 55분 걸렸어요. 서연은 7시 25분에 도착했어요. Now how good be reason ‘지하철이 안 와서 늦었어요’?
z-k-01-03.s.s2.hint.1: Remove the waiting once, then remove slow ride once, and compare each arrival with 7:00.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.o.a: Part of reason: without wait she still for reach 7:05.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.r.a: Recalculate with new facts and compare both reasons.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.o.b: The whole reason: without the wait she for reach on time.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.r.b: Keep first answer without checking times again.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.o.c: No reason at all: without slow ride she for reach on time.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.r.c: Ignore the wait; without slow ride she still for reach at 7:10, late.
z-k-01-03.s.s2.explain: 6:10 + 20-minute wait + 55-minute ride = 7:25. Without wait arrival 7:05, still 5 minutes late; without slow train, arrival 7:10, still 10 minutes late. Both facts matter, so one reason alone no explain lateness.
z-k-01-03.s.s3.prompt: Write for Korean wetin 서연 suppose tell her friend to include both reasons. Use -아서/어서 (or -고, -니까).
z-k-01-03.s.s3.hint.0: Write one sentence for wait and another for slow ride.
z-k-01-03.s.s3.hint.1: End at least one of dem with 늦었어요.
z-k-01-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I include both wait and slow ride?
z-k-01-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Each reason connect to lateness, no just sit beside am?
z-k-01-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: My friend go understand why she reach by 7:25?
z-k-01-03.s.s3.modelNote.3: Describe slow ride as taking more time.

z-k-01-05.title: Make three sentences true at once
z-k-01-05.topic: Put events in order with -기 전에 / -(으)ㄴ 후에
z-k-01-05.goal: Decide whether two sentences set an order, find every order wey fit three sentences, and say wetin certain and wetin still open.
z-k-01-05.material:
하준 describe weekday morning. He do four things, each once, one after another: 운동 (exercise), 샤워 (shower), 아침 (breakfast), 출근 (leave for work). He say three things:
① 샤워하기 전에 운동해요.
② 아침을 먹은 후에 출근해요.
③ 운동을 한 후에 아침을 먹어요.
z-k-01-05.thinking.2: Explain wetin fixed and wetin free
z-k-01-05.prereq.1: Fit read short sentences about daily routine
z-k-01-05.s.s1.prompt: Use only ① and ②. E certain say 운동 happen before 출근?
z-k-01-05.s.s1.hint.0: Draw each sentence like two boxes, use arrow from earlier event to later event.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.hint.1: Check if same box dey appear for both drawing.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.o.a: No: ① and ② na separate pairs; nothing connect dem.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.r.a: E check which events each sentence really connect.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.o.b: Yes: 운동 appear first, so e happen first.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.r.b: E use word order for story as event order.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.o.c: Yes: people dey shower before work, so 운동 earlier too.
z-k-01-05.s.s1.r.c: E bring everyday habit instead of using only sentences.

z-k-01-07.material:

z-k-01-08.title: Who fail di test?
z-k-01-08.topic: E happen? (-ㄹ 뻔했다, -는 바람에, -ㄹ까 봐, -ㄹ 줄 알았는데)

z-k-01-08.thinking.0: Tell wetin sentence guarantee from wetin e only suggest

z-k-01-08.prereq.1: E know -ㄹ까 봐 (fear that) and -ㄹ 줄 알았는데 (think say ... but)

z-k-01-09.title: Summary fair?
z-k-01-09.goal: Check whether summary with '-(으)ㄴ/는 셈이다' really follow from numbers before am, choose fair summaries for one case, and write your own.
z-k-01-09.material:
Four people summarise their practice with -(으)ㄴ/는 셈이다 ('e come to ...'). Each summary suppose follow from numbers before am. (1시간 = 60분)

1. 매일 30분씩 일주일 동안 걸었으니까 모두 세 시간 반을 걸은 셈이에요.
2. 하루에 20분씩 6일 연습했으니까 한 시간 연습한 셈이에요.
3. 일주일에 세 번, 한 번에 40분씩 수영하니까 한 주에 두 시간 수영하는 셈이에요.
4. 하루에 두 시간씩 5일 공부했으니까 열 시간 공부한 셈이에요.

z-k-01-09.s.s1.hint.1: Use same unit for numbers and total before you compare dem.
z-k-01-09.s.s1.explain: Line 2: 20분 x 6일 = 120분 = 2시간, no be 한 시간. Line 1: 30분 x 7 = 210분 = 3시간 반 (correct). Line 3: 40분 x 3 = 120분 = 2시간 (correct). Line 4: 2시간 x 5 = 10시간 (correct).
z-k-01-09.s.s2.prompt: Somebody exercise 일주일에 네 번, 한 번에 50분씩. Which summaries fair? (남짓 mean 'small pass'.) Choose all wey fit.

z-k-01-09.s.s2.hint.1: Then ask for each choice: figure wey e name close to that time?

z-k-01-09.s.s2.r.b: 남짓 mean small bit more than number wey dem mention, so 네 시간 남짓 pass 240 minutes, more than 200 minutes here.
z-k-01-09.s.s2.r.d: E round 3 hours 20 minutes too high; ‘거의 다섯 시간’ na about 4 h 40 min or more.
z-k-01-09.s.s2.explain: 4 x 50 = 200분 = 3시간 20분, small more than 3 hours (세 시간 남짓) and just under 세 시간 반 (210분). 거의 다섯 시간 (300분), 두 시간 반 (150분) and 네 시간 남짓 (over 240분) all far off.

z-k-01-10.title: Pricey always better?
z-k-01-10.goal: Judge how well -(으)ㄹ수록 claim fit table, build counterexample pairs using table, then rewrite claim so e fit data.
z-k-01-10.material:
Blogger write: ‘커피는 값이 비쌀수록 만족도가 높다.’ (-(으)ㄹ수록 = the more ..., the more ...). Survey of six cafes give this table. 만족도 = satisfaction score out of 10. Cafes dey numbered from cheapest (1) to most expensive (6).

번호 1: 3,000원, 만족도 6점
번호 2: 4,000원, 만족도 8점
번호 3: 5,000원, 만족도 7점
번호 4: 6,500원, 만족도 9점
번호 5: 8,000원, 만족도 6점
번호 6: 9,000원, 만족도 8점
z-k-01-10.thinking.1: Build counterexamples wey meet exact conditions
z-k-01-10.thinking.2: Rewrite claim to match how strong the data support am
z-k-01-10.prereq.1: Know 대체로, 항상, 꼭 and negative endings
z-k-01-10.prereq.2: Fit compare two numbers in a table
z-k-01-10.s.s1.prompt: How well blogger sentence fit the table?
z-k-01-10.s.s1.hint.0: Choose two cafes anyhow and check which one cost more and which score higher.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.hint.1: Do am with some pairs before you decide.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.o.a: E fit all but one cafe: only 번호 5 break the pattern.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.r.a: Blame one unusual cafe and miss other pairs wey break am, like 번호 2 and 3.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.o.b: No be every pair agree, but more expensive cafes score small higher on average.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.r.b: Compare pairs and general pattern separately.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.o.c: E fit almost every pair; only a few ties go against am.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.r.c: Five pairs get more expensive cafe with LOWER score, no be only ties.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.o.d: Na opposite: on average the more expensive cafes get lower score.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.r.d: Three more expensive cafes average around 7.7 points and three cheaper ones 7.0, so average no go opposite direction.
z-k-01-10.s.s1.explain: Some pairs agree with claim (1 and 2), some break am (2 and 3, 4 and 5). Three pricier cafes average around 7.7 and three cheaper ones 7.0, so weak trend dey, but claim no work for every pair.
z-k-01-10.s.s2.prompt: Find two counterexamples: cafe pairs where cafe a cheaper than cafe b, but cafe b get LOWER score than cafe a. Enter two cafe numbers.
z-k-01-10.s.s2.hint.0: Choose cafe with high score and check cafes after am wey cost more.

z-k-01-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Use whole cafe numbers from 1 to 6.

z-k-01-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Cafe a must be the cheaper one (smaller number).
z-k-01-10.s.s2.ok.c3: The more expensive cafe get lower score.

z-k-01-10.s.s2.explain: Five pairs break the claim: (2,3), (2,5), (3,5), (4,5), (4,6). For example, 번호 2 cost 4,000원 and get 8 points, but pricier 번호 3 (5,000원) get only 7. Pairs with equal score (like 2 and 6) no be ‘higher’ too, but dem no list here.

z-k-01-12.title: Connector wey point wrong way
z-k-01-12.topic: Cause and contrast connectors in news summary
z-k-01-12.goal: Find summary sentence where connector claim more than report, choose connectors wey no do that, then write your own contrast sentence.
z-k-01-12.material:
News report give these facts (all true):
① 학교가 급식 시간을 20분에서 30분으로 늘렸다.
② 줄 서는 시간이 평균 12분에서 7분으로 줄었다. 보도는 급식 시간 연장이 그 이유라고 밝혔다 (report say longer lunch time na reason).
③ 학생 만족도는 62%에서 55%로 낮아졌다. 보도는 그 이유를 밝히지 않았다 (report no give reason for this).

Student summarize report:
1. 학교는 급식 시간을 20분에서 30분으로 늘렸다.
2. 그래서 줄 서는 시간이 평균 12분에서 7분으로 줄었다.
3. 그래서 학생 만족도는 62%에서 55%로 낮아졌다.
4. 이처럼 급식 시간을 늘렸지만 학생 만족도는 오르지 않았다.
z-k-01-12.thinking.1: Choose between connectors with different strength
z-k-01-12.prereq.1: Fit read short news-style sentences with numbers and percentages
z-k-01-12.s.s1.prompt: Which sentence use connector wey claim more than report talk?
z-k-01-12.s.s1.hint.0: For every 그래서 ask: report talk say first fact cause second one?
z-k-01-12.s.s1.hint.1: For both lines with 그래서, check the facts again and note wetin report itself say about reason.
z-k-01-12.s.s1.explain: Line 3 use 그래서, wey say satisfaction drop na result of wetin come before. Report no give reason for drop, and shorter queue no obvious reason for less satisfaction. Line 2 get support: report say longer lunch time cause shorter queue. Line 4 use 지만 for contrast, and e fit facts.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.prompt: Which connectors fit replace 그래서 in line 3 without claiming more than report? Choose all wey apply.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.hint.0: Sort connectors by whether dem mean ‘as a result’ or ‘in spite of’.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.hint.1: Keep ones wey no make any claim about reason.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.r.a: Mark drop as conclusion wey follow the previous line.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.r.b: Contrast the drop with improvement before.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.r.d: Contrast the drop with improvement before.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.r.c: Make drop a result, like 그래서.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.r.e: Say drop happen despite the improvement.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.explain: 그럼에도, 하지만 and 그런데도 show contrast without claiming cause. 따라서 and 그러므로 claim a result, like 그래서, wey report no support.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.acc.0: Correct but not complete: 그런데도 work too.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.acc.1: Correct but not complete: 하지만 work too.
z-k-01-12.s.s2.acc.2: Correct but not complete: 그럼에도 work too.
z-k-01-12.s.s3.prompt: Here another report: 버스 요금을 1,500원에서 1,200원으로 내렸다. 하루 이용객은 8,000명으로 그대로였다. Write these two facts in Korean as connected sentences, with connector wey no claim a cause.
z-k-01-12.s.s3.hint.0: Write fare fact first, then passenger fact.
z-k-01-12.s.s3.hint.1: Think of passenger fact as unexpected after fare fact.
z-k-01-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I join facts with contrast, no be result?
z-k-01-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: The numbers from report dey inside my sentences?
z-k-01-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Reader fit think say I claim one fact cause the other?
